title: Magi: The Labyrinth of Magic
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Loosely inspired by One Thousand and One Nights, the story follows Aladdin, a boy who learns he is a Magi, and his friend Alibaba as they conquer magical dungeons and gain the power of djinn. Their journey widens into wars between nations, the fight against slavery and a secret group, Al-Thamen, that seeks to revive a destructive deity.
life_message: It holds up choosing one's own path against fate, freeing the oppressed and building peace among nations through cooperation.

Dungeon trials, war and villains seeking world destruction.

Mild insults typical of shonen (to verify).
Adult characters drink, including comic drunkenness (to verify).
Slavery and psychological bondage; despair called 'falling into depravity'.
Large media franchise (anime, games) but no in-story promotion.

winners_losers: Aladdin, Alibaba and allies who reject fatalism and free the enslaved prevail; Al-Thamen and imperial conquest lose. Sympathy goes to cooperation and self-determination.
